title: Confirm destructive actions or provide undo
problemCues: Delete or irreversible bulk action with a single click and no recovery
preconditions: Action cannot be trivially reversed by the user
decision: Confirm destructive actions or provide Undo. Do not rely on toast alone for irreversible writes.
exceptions: Low-risk reversible toggles with clear off state
validatedBy: Usability includes confirm or undo path
